highlights.title: Windows Settings stops a false warning
highlights.line: Settings, Computer no longer says it could not tell which user Kosmos runs as, from a check that never applied here.

highlights.title: Codex edits on Windows say who made them
highlights.line: A file a Codex agent changes on Windows now records the agent as its writer, with an undo copy.

highlights.title: Removing Kosmos takes out its agent hooks
highlights.line: Removing Kosmos on Windows takes its Gemini and Codex hooks out of your agents' settings, and leaves your own.

highlights.title: The restart note says what was checked
highlights.line: After this computer restarts, the note says how many agents came back, names any that did not, and whether Kosmos's main records read fine.

highlights.title: A little more room between chat lines
highlights.line: Messages in an agent conversation on the computer now have a little more space between lines.
